name: INTERP-v2i-interact
args: v2i: v2g curated products + v2h asymmetric (odd-order) nonlinearities. 40 raw → 160 post-delay. Tests whether asymmetric + product features combine additively.

name: INTERP-v2l-interact
args: v2l: v2g products (10) + v2j cross-lag (6) + v2k per-band odd (60). 76 raw → 304 post-delay. Full curated nonlinear kit.

name: INTERP-v2n-interact
args: v2n: v2g products (10) + v2h asymmetric (30) + v2j cross-lag (6). 46 raw → 184 post-delay. Tests full composition vs v2m=0.0766 best.

name: INTERP-v2o-interact
args: v2o: v2h asymmetric (30) + multi-scale cross-lag k=2,4,8 (=67/133/267ms): 6 pair types × 3 lags = 18. 48 raw → 192 post-delay. Tests multi-scale temporal products.

name: INTERP-v2p-interact
args: v2p: v2m + asymmetric on formant 1-D (f1_loc, f2_loc, f1_amp, f2_amp): 4 sigs × {ReLU+, ReLU-, z^3} = 12. 48 raw → 192 post-delay.
